judges.21.p1.b1.text: Now the men of Israel had sworn an oath at Mizpah, saying, “Not one of us will give his daughter in marriage to a Benjamite.”

judges.21.p1.b2.text: So the people came to Bethel and sat there before God until evening, lifting up their voices and weeping bitterly.

judges.21.p1.b3.text: Why, O LORD God of Israel, … has this happened in Israel? Today in Israel one tribe is missing!

judges.21.p1.b4.text: The next day the people got up early, built an altar there, and presented burnt offerings and peace offerings.

judges.21.p2.b1.text: Who among all the tribes of Israel did not come to the assembly before the LORD?

judges.21.p2.b2.text: Today a tribe is cut off from Israel.

judges.21.p2.b3.text: What should we do about wives for the survivors, since we have sworn by the LORD not to give them our daughters in marriage?

judges.21.p2.b4.text: And, in fact, no one from Jabesh-gilead had come to the camp for the assembly.

judges.21.p3.b1.text: So the congregation sent 12,000 of their most valiant men

judges.21.p3.b2.text: … Go and put to the sword those living in Jabesh-gilead, including women and children.

judges.21.p3.b3.text: So they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young women who had not had relations with a man, and they brought them to the camp at Shiloh in the land of Canaan.

judges.21.p4.b1.text: Then the whole congregation sent a message of peace to the Benjamites who were at the rock of Rimmon.

judges.21.p4.b2.text: And at that time the Benjamites returned and were given the women who were spared from Jabesh-gilead. But there were not enough women for all of them.

judges.21.p4.b3.text: The people grieved for Benjamin, because the LORD had made a void in the tribes of Israel.

judges.21.p5.b1.text: What should we do about wives for those who remain, since the women of Benjamin have been destroyed?

judges.21.p5.b2.text: But we cannot give them our daughters as wives.

judges.21.p5.b3.text: … there is a yearly feast to the LORD in Shiloh, which is north of Bethel east of the road that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah.

judges.21.p6.b1.text: Go, hide in the vineyards and watch. When you see the daughters of Shiloh come out to perform their dances, each of you is to come out of the vineyards, … and go to the land of Benjamin.

judges.21.p6.b2.text: Do us a favor by helping them, … Since you did not actually give them your daughters, you have no guilt.

judges.21.p6.b3.text: The Benjamites did as instructed … They went back to their own inheritance, rebuilt their cities, and settled in them.

judges.21.p7.b1.text: And at that time, each of the Israelites returned from there to his own tribe and clan, each to his own inheritance.

judges.21.p7.b2.text: In those days there was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
